name: Theme Button
description: A pill button that morphs into a picker menu on click using a shared layoutId. Click the font name to choose a typeface or the color swatch to choose a theme. Fully configurable: pass your own themes/fonts (list or function), control the selection, and react to picks via onThemeChange/onFontChange. The shell springs open with an Apple-style expand/collapse, content cross-fades with a blur, and the whole surface is theme-token aware for light and dark.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Click the font name or the color swatch — the sample text below reacts to your pick
variations.description: Collapsed status pill morphs into an expanded font or theme list via a shared layoutId spring, with a blur cross-fade on the inner content. Themes/fonts, selection, and change callbacks are all props. Includes an inlined iOS pulse spinner so the block ships self-contained.

props.name: themes
props.description: Theme options as a list or a function returning one. Each: { id, label, dots: string[] }. Falls back to the built-in set.

props.name: fonts
props.description: Font options as a list or a function returning one. Each: { id, label, stack }. Falls back to the built-in set.

props.name: defaultThemeId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial theme selection, by id.

props.name: defaultFontId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial font selection, by id.

props.name: themeId
props.description: Controlled theme selection, by id. When set, the theme dimension is controlled.

props.name: fontId
props.description: Controlled font selection, by id. When set, the font dimension is controlled.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Fires with the full option after a theme is picked — do whatever you want with it.

props.name: onFontChange
props.description: Fires with the full option after a font is picked.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the menu opens ('font' | 'theme') or closes (null).

props.name: processLabel
props.description: Label shown next to the spinner segment.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the pill shell.

features: Fully prop-driven: pass themes/fonts as a list or a function, control selection, and react via onThemeChange/onFontChange/onOpenChange
Controlled or uncontrolled per dimension — works with zero props out of the box
Two morph targets: the font name opens a typeface picker, the color swatch opens the theme picker
iOS pulse spinner is inlined verbatim (not imported) so the downloaded block is self-contained
Shared layoutId morph between collapsed pill and expanded menu — Motion interpolates size, position, and border-radius
Apple-style spring: expand is slower (bigger travel), collapse ~30% faster
Inner content cross-fades with a blur; exit is faster so it clears the morph
Full-row / full-segment hit targets — the whole option is clickable, not just its text and icon
Full APG menu keyboard model: opening moves focus into the menu, Arrow/Home/End rove between options (roving tabindex), Enter/Space select, Escape closes and refocuses the trigger
Focus is returned to the opening trigger on Escape/selection; outside-click dismissal leaves focus where the user clicked
Dismissible: closes on outside click or Escape; triggers and menu carry aria-haspopup/expanded and role=menu/menuitemradio; decorative spinner/dots/dividers are aria-hidden
Surface uses popover/accent/border tokens so it flips correctly in light and dark
prefers-reduced-motion: springs and the spinner collapse to instant
